description: Na₅CoO₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pmn2₁ space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.71 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent CoO₄ tetrahedra, corners with six NaO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one CoO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.46 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four equivalent CoO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.55 Å. Co is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted CoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with eight NaO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 1.88-1.93 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Co atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₅Co pentagonal pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 69-71°. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to seven Na and one Co atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Co atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₅Co octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 40-53°.
